visualCharacteristics.purpose: authored replacement for a third-party reviews widget: overall rating, star distribution and individual reviews

contentPattern.structure: summary rows (heading/text, score cell such as "4.3", review-count link); distribution rows [5 stars] [1110]; review rows [rating number] [title heading, author/date, review text] [details (optional)]. A cell holding only a /fragments/ link loads that fragment

reuseGuidance: Use where the source embeds a reviews widget; author a curated list or load reviews from a fragment.
